description: This file defines a Java interface 'PolicyQueryCommandResponse' that represents responses to policy query commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends other interfaces to include entity setting and header handling functionalities, and is parametrized for fluent method chaining.

classes.name: PolicyQueryCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing the response to a policy query, capable of setting entity data and headers, designed for implementation by classes that encapsulate responses to policy queries.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity data in the response, returning the instance for chaining.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers in the response, returning the instance for chaining.
